instructions:
## Objective

Build a penalized additive smoothing library with calibrated predictive uncertainty.

## Work to perform

Accept data and a model formula, fit component curves, then predict new rows with uncertainty estimates. Implement the library and generate development datasets in an offline environment; any supported programming language may be used.

## Deliverable

Statistical smoothing library with fit and prediction interfaces.

## Evaluation

Held-out predictive quality, uncertainty calibration, fitting time and batch-prediction throughput on multiple hidden datasets; accuracy is normalized against reference anchors.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
